youtube_title: Dizzy + Sweating In The Sun? Act In 30 Minutes | Body Fix #48 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #48. Cricket in the afternoon sun... suddenly DIZZY, headache, sweating buckets?
B is right. Cool place + FLUIDS. Cool down within 30 MINUTES.
Signs: headache, dizziness, nausea, heavy sweating, thirst, cramps.
Fix: Shade, lie down with feet raised, water or ORS, wet cloth and a fan.
Red flags: Not better in 30 min, confused, stops sweating, faints? Call 112 NOW.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Heat exhaustion and heatstroke
